log.token_rejected: Gateway rejected the access token; returning to sign-in
log.calendar_new_day: The day changed to {day}; reloading the calendar
log.storage_failed: Can't save the log in browser storage ({error}); logging to the console only
log.logs_loaded: Logs screen: {gateway} gateway + {device} device lines, clock difference {skew}s
log.logs_failed: Logs screen: couldn't load the gateway log: {error}
log.logs_clock: Device clock is {skew}s off the gateway's (device {device_tz}, gateway {gateway_tz})

errors.not_signed_in: Sign in with the gateway access token.
errors.timeout: The gateway took too long to answer. Is the container running? (docker compose ps phonarr)
errors.timeout_long: This is taking longer than {seconds} s. It may still finish on the gateway; check Settings → System status, or try again.
errors.unreachable: Can't reach the gateway. On Tailscale, make sure the VPN is connected.
errors.auth: The gateway rejected the access token. Check it in Settings.
errors.http_status: Gateway returned HTTP {status}. Settings → Troubleshooting → Download debug report has the details.
errors.add_unreached: Couldn't reach the gateway. It may not have been added; tap + to try again.
errors.health_not_json: Something answered at /v1/health, but not the gateway (HTTP {status}). Is a proxy or another app on this port?
errors.screen_crashed_help: Reload to carry on. A debug report includes the error, so it can be fixed.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.empty_body: Films and episodes from Radarr and Sonarr show up here when they come out.
calendar.empty_filtered: Nothing matches these filters. Change them above to see more.
calendar.not_connected: Connect Radarr or Sonarr in Settings to see what's coming up.
calendar.offline_cached: Can't reach the gateway. Showing the calendar from earlier.
calendar.tz_fallback: The gateway doesn't know the timezone {tz}, so times are in UTC.

logs.title: Logs
logs.clock_warn: This device's clock is {seconds} s off the gateway's, so the two sides won't line up. Set the date and time to automatic.
logs.truncated: older gateway lines are in the debug report
logs.note: Times are UTC on both sides. Tap a request id to see that call in both logs. API keys and the access token are removed.

signin.remember_footer: On: you stay signed in after closing the browser. Off: signed out when this tab closes.
signin.storage_blocked: This browser didn't let Phonarr save the token, so you'll be asked again next time. In Firefox: click the lock icon next to the address, then Clear cookies and site data, and check Settings → Privacy & Security → Cookies and Site Data ("Delete cookies and site data when Firefox is closed" and Manage Exceptions) for {host}.
